title: Photoredox-enabled late-stage functionalization of pyrrolidines in batch and flow: rapid access to benzothiazole hybrids as a new class of cholinesterase inhibitors
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,17972-17982
DOI: 10.1039/D6RA01041E, Paper

A. Filipović, M. Vučkovski, D. Mićović, A. M. Bondžić, B. P. Bondžić
A visible-light-driven photoredox protocol for the α-amino C(sp3)–H heteroarylation of N-aryl pyrrolidines and piperidines with 2-chlorobenzothiazole derivatives in batch and in flow conditions is developed.
